description: Commit 4d82aab independently rounds each requested multi-GPU tile share to a multiple of 16 and assigns the discrepancy to the final share, which can make that share negative.
trigger: A multi-GPU quantization call with 32 tiles and device_ratios [3, 3, 3, 1].
expected_behavior: Every size passed to torch.split is a nonnegative integer and the sizes sum to the tile count.
actual_behavior: The arithmetic produces [16, 16, 16, -16] and passes it to torch.split before the later positive-share guard.

introductions.scope: The task diff introduces ratio-based share calculation, independent 16-tile rounding and final-share discrepancy adjustment.

observations.source: Commit 28 authoring finding and independent Fable mailbox review.
observations.reach: The negative list reaches three torch.split calls before the per-device split_sizes[i] > 0 guard.
observations.limits: The condition is narrow. The reviewer tried nine ratio lists over tile counts 32 through 512 and found only the recorded example negative; this was not an exhaustive search.

limits: Plain Python executed a transcription of the arithmetic, not repository imports or CUDA quantization.
Torch was unavailable, so the exact torch.split exception was not observed.
The triggering space was sampled, not exhaustively enumerated.

source.artifact: Commit-28 ratio arithmetic and source scan

impact.rationale: A narrow but valid ratio/tile combination reaches an invalid split before GPU work; exact framework failure text and prevalence are unobserved.

administrative_review_status: Commit-28 authoring finding independently confirmed by Fable; ledger candidate awaits independent review.
